# OpenSRM Service Reliability Manifest
# Migrated from legacy NthLayer format
# Original file: analytics-pipeline.yaml
#
# For more information, see:
# https://github.com/rsionnach/opensrm
#

apiVersion: srm/v1
kind: ServiceReliabilityManifest
metadata:
  name: analytics-pipeline
  team: data
  tier: standard
spec:
  type: batch
  slos:
    freshness-p95:
      target: 90.0
      window: 30d
    data-quality:
      target: 99.0
      window: 30d
  dependencies:
  - name: analytics-warehouse
    type: database
    critical: true
  - name: raw-data-lake
    type: database
    critical: true
  ownership:
    team: data
